name: dsh-capability-receipt
description: Content-addressed receipts for skills actually loaded by DeepSeek Harness

interface.shortDescription: Prove which skill DSH actually loaded.
interface.longDescription: Observes the winning DeepSeek Harness skill definition at runtime, hashes its effective instruction body and bounded local resource closure, checks pinned expectations, and writes a deterministic content-addressed receipt without disclosing source text or absolute paths.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect the effective DSH skill, then issue a receipt against hashes pinned by its trusted source artifact.
